Subject: Questions on termination / auto-renew in MSA and order form

Hi Marissa,

Quick follow-up from our procurement review — two items we need clarity on before we can finalize the PO:

1) Auto-renew mechanics: The order form references a 12-month auto-renew unless either party gives notice. Can you confirm whether Redwood will consider a shorter auto-renew cap (12+1 month rolling capped at 24 months) or a one-time waiver for pilots if we commit to a 12-month initial term?

2) Termination for convenience: Nimbus prefers a 60-day notice for termination for convenience on the order form (we know the MSA has a standard 90-day window). Is Redwood open to aligning the order form to 60 days for this account?

We've attached the internal procurement checklist for context. If you prefer, we can take a call tomorrow morning to run through.

Best,
Sara

Subject: Re: Questions on termination / auto-renew in MSA and order form

Hi Sara — thanks for laying these out. High level answers and proposed next steps below.

Auto-renew: We can do a pilot-friendly accommodation. Proposal: initial 12-month term + one automatic 12-month renewal (i.e., max 24 months). For pilots converted within the first 12 months we can include a one-time waiver that prevents the auto-renew from triggering for that conversion window.

Termination for convenience: We prefer 90 days in the MSA as a baseline, but will consider 60 days in the order form as an account-level carveout if legal signs off and we include a short wind-down SOW for data export/transfer.

Next steps: looping in Contracts/Legal to draft the order-form carveouts and a short off-ramp SOW. Karthik & Laura — could you take a look at the two bullets below and suggest redline language?

- Order form clause: "Notwithstanding Section X of the MSA, the parties agree that the Order Form Term shall be twelve (12) months with one (1) automatic twelve (12) month renewal unless Customer provides written notice at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term."
- Off-ramp SOW: short clause defining data export timeline (30 days), assist-level (standard), and escrow for dev resources (optional).

Happy to jump on a quick call with Sara tomorrow 10am PT if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Sara — thanks. I drafted two quick options and attached a redline for the MSA + order form. TL;DR: we can accept the 60-day order-form carveout if Nimbus accepts a short wind-down SOW and a one-time transition fee scaled to 10% of monthly committed ARR to cover incremental scheduling risk.

Option A (preferred): Order form carveout to 60 days + Off-ramp SOW (30-day export SLA + standard assistance) + no transition fee if the customer elects the waiver before the auto-renew window triggers (i.e., during months 1–6).

Option B: 60-day carveout + 10% transition fee for cancellations between months 7–12 to cover reallocation of dedicated capacity.

Please see attached redline (redline_MSA_20270309.docx) with inline comments. Laura — please mark up for legal's comfort; particularly curious on whether we can make the transition fee a function of TCV rather than ARR.

-Karthik

Subject: Re: Questions on termination / auto-renew in MSA and order form

Hi all — reviewed the proposed options. From a legal/compliance standpoint we can proceed with Option A as long as: 

1) The Off-ramp SOW includes clear data handling/export timelines and confidentiality obligations (30 days for full export; interim read-only access until export completes).
2) The one-time waiver window is strictly time-boxed (we suggest months 1–6 as proposed) and non-transferable.
3) Include a customer acknowledgement in the order form that AWS/GCP region pinning for Dedicated instances may require up to 45 days to decommission depending on hardware scheduling.

I removed the flat 10% transition fee from the MSA redline and suggested a TCV-proportional dilution clause instead (language in the attached redline). If Nimbus is sensitive to fees, Option A with the time-boxed waiver + off-ramp SOW is our safest commercial compromise.

Marissa / Karthik — I can turn this into a clean contract addendum and order-form amendment by Friday. Sara — if that works for Nimbus, we can prepare the DocuSign bundle and target signature next week.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
